jobs.employer_name: INM - Leibniz-Institut für Neue Materialien gGmbH
jobs.description: The INM-Leibniz Institute for New Materials is an internationally leading center for interdisciplinary research on materials, and their exploitation in materials-based solutions for a sustainable world with increasing digitalization and medical needs. Our research integrates materials chemistry, biological processes, physical analysis, process engineering and data science. We collaborate with academic and industrial partners all around the world.A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials at the interface between materials science and synthetic biology, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological and medical fields. Our institute develops safe-by-design concepts for responsible ELM innovation.To lead a community-driven initiative in ELMs, we seek aResearcher in Regulatory Affairs of biotechnology/biomedical products (f/m/d)to perform research on the needs, challenges, expectations and best practices for the development of safe and sustainable ELM-based technologies in the future, and to elaborate guidelines for researchers and developers of ELMs. The scientist will coordinate and work together with a knowledge-exchange network with experts from relevant stakeholders with interest in ELM research, innovation and regulation (academic institutions, industry, consultants, regulatory agencies). This project is framed within the collaborative network MaterialVital Hub, funded by the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR).Analysis of needs, challenges and upcoming expectations for ELM regulation through interviews and dedicated workshops with experts.Systematic analysis and documentation of existing frameworks of relevance for ELM regulation.Elaboration of praxis-oriented guidelines, decision-making trees and proposing metrics for safe-by-design approaches in ELM research that help integrating safety aspects at early stage of materials design.Communication of the results in the form of white papers or scientific publications.Reporting to project coordinator, partners and funding agencies.PhD in Regulatory Affairs related to biotechnological or pharmaceutical topics. Alternatively, a PhD in biomedical materials, pharmaceutical science or microbiology, with experience in clinical translation of cell therapies. Applicants with MSc degree in natural, engineering or life sciences and previous experience in regulatory affairs at the industry or regulatory agencies are also welcome.Interest in inter- and transdisciplinary challenges.Strong analytical skills.Proactive, problem-solving, structured and autonomous working style.Writing and communication skills in German and English.An interesting and timely topic with high visibility and opportunities for interaction with public and private partners.Possibilities for further training and qualification.A network of interested partners to collaborate with you and support your work.A dynamic environment with substantial room for creativity, profile and career development.A professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.A well structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunityA family-friendly working place.A EG 13 TV-L position (full time), initially for 3 years. A part time position is also possible.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.occupation: GlobalFoundries Management Services GmbH & Co. KG: PhD on Predictive Process Machine Control (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
jobs.employer_name: GlobalFoundries Management Services GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: About GFGlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors that enable AI at scale, from the cloud to the physical world. We partner closely with our customers to deliver differentiated, power-efficient, high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. Across our global footprint in the United States, Europe and Asia, our teams are solving complex challenges that shape the future of technology. At GF, you'll find the opportunity to make an impact, work with world-class talent and contribute to a more secure, sustainable future.Your JobIn semiconductor manufacturing, no processing machine runs continuously yielding the same results. Materials used in the machine can degrade over time, simple factors like –outside temperature can fluctuate, and high usage and low usage play a roll. For stable process results, specific machine settings and recipe parameters are tuned automatically or manually. This is an essential part of work for our process and equipment experts.As a PhD candidate, you will be looking differently at our machines and processes. You already have a scientist´s or an engineer´s view. You know and see the parameters available, regardless of current usage. There, your journey starts towards finding the optimal machine and process settings with as few as possible latest data points. Latest advances in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence indicate the possibility for improvements and will guide your research.The goal of this work shall be the summary and testing of state-of-the-art methods in real-world applications as well as development of new methods tailored to the needs of the semiconductor industry, so in this work Data Science approaches are to be developed to enable process experts to use ML and AI for machine and process tuning.   The contract for this position is set up for 3 years with the possibility to extend it by one additional year, if required. We are looking for a research associate who wants to take a coordinating role in a joint project with other partners from academia and industry and in aligning their research work to the requirements of later mass production. You will systematically document and present the results in regular reports. jobs.description: About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH isthe joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the firsttime, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab inthe heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologiesfor next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a sharedcommitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. Forour future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated andcommitted: Hardware Engineer (m/w/d) Become the heart of our fabautomation. The Automated Material Handling System (AMHS) will be thenervous system of our fab. As an AMHS Hardware Engineer, you’ll be atechnical expert, designer, problem-solver, and team leader. You’llensure that our wafer transport systems (transfer tools, sorters, N2systems) operate at maximum efficiency. Tasks You will be responsiblefor the installation, commissioning, and continuous improvement of ourAMHS hardware. For complex issues, you will conduct root causeanalyses (8D, FMEA, SPC) and implement sustainable solutions. You willlead cross-functional projects aimed at improving productivity,quality, and cost efficiency—from planning through to performancereview. You will evaluate new equipment and materials, work closelywith suppliers, and develop in-house hardware solutions to meetoperational needs. You will lead and mentor a team of technicians andjunior engineers, share your knowledge, and foster team spirit throughclear communication. You will actively assist with installation andcoordinate upgrades in close collaboration with other departments.Profile You are a proactive team player who thrives in a dynamic,fast-paced environment and is willing to take on responsibility. AMaster’s degree in Engineering, such as Mechanical or ElectricalEngineering, Automation, or a related field. Professional experiencein the semiconductor industry is required. In-depth knowledge ofoptimization algorithms, control systems, and mechanical automation.Proficiency in quality tools such as SPC, FMEA, and 8Dproblem-solving. Hands-on mentality, resilience, and the ability tomotivate and lead teams professionally. Fluent in English (companylanguage). Basic communication skills in Mandarin or German is a plus.Available for on-the-job training in Taiwan, 9 to 12 months. We offerSecurity & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and careeradvancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductorsfabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support yourfinancial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMCemployee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance throughan exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Relocation Supportfor Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the supportyou will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden. Training& Development: Depending on your position, you will gain a deeperunderstanding of the processes involved in operating complexsemiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training at the TSMCNewcomer Training Center, while continuously expanding your knowledge.Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being(e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stayfit. Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as asubsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket) inGermany. Additional contact details Please apply with your Englishresume.
